product.title: Edge-Lit Chroma Countertop
product.description: Made with our light-loving Chroma material, this product uses an Avalanche opaque layer to conceal the base attachment, and comes with a proprietary LED illumination and controller.

specs.name: What You Get
specs.value: A 96" (2440 mm) long with a 6" (152 mm) minimum and 24" (610 mm) maximum depth Chroma countertop with RGB lighting.

specs.name: Product Features
specs.value: Countertop is 96" long (2440 mm) 1" gauge Chroma countertop uses an opaque white layer called Avalanche to conceal attachment to the substrate Proprietary LED illumination inside a fabricated channel Avalanche backing can be glued to sub-top with recommended overhang for access to LED lighting Utilizes our standard 3flex RGB series edge lighting solution with a monochromatic RGB controller
